title: Signed dictator under a coordinate extension
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $i$ be a coordinate in $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, let $\varepsilon\in\{\text{false},\text{true}\}$ specify whether the dictator is negated, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Extend $x$ to length $n+1$ by placing $-1$ first. The signed dictator at this extended vector equals the negative of its value at the vector formed by placing $1$ first and negating every coordinate of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: the negation flag is a Boolean value
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
